title: Access Levels in One File
hints: An extension in the same file counts as "inside" for `private`.
Add a separate type that tries to read the private property.
jsBridge: `private` in Swift is scoped to the declaration **plus its extensions in the same file**, not the whole class like TS `private`, and not the whole file like `fileprivate`. The file boundary matters in Swift, which JS modules only approximate.
